      About

      I design and lead AI systems that do real work: agents that plan and act across the software lifecycle, retrieval that grounds every answer, and data platforms enterprises rely on. Six years of it: now at KnackForge, before that NTT DATA and Airbus.

      What I’m building now

      Agentic AI across the software lifecycle

      At KnackForge I lead Agentic AI work for an AI-assisted software lifecycle: multi-agent workflows with defined agent roles, orchestration, tool integration and enterprise integration. I own the product side too, from requirements and roadmaps to delivery.

      1. RequirementsA business problem goes in, structured requirements come out.
      2. PlanningRequirements become a prioritised plan.
      3. DevelopmentCode is drafted against the plan and the codebase.
      4. TestingTests run and failures loop back to development.
      5. DocumentationDocs stay in step with every change.
      6. DeliveryReleases move out through CI/CD.
